fields.name: Language
fields.description: Select the language for this sentence. The language determines script rules and validation.
fields.guidance: Choose the primary language this sentence belongs to. Once set, this cannot be changed later.

fields.name: Native Sentence Text
fields.description: Enter the complete sentence in its native script. This must be a grammatically correct, complete sentence.
fields.guidance: Write complete sentences that demonstrate natural usage. Use proper punctuation. Examples: 'मी तुम्हाला नमस्कार करतो.' (I greet you.), 'तो शाळेत जातो.' (He goes to school.).

actions: Link the sentence to one or more Lemmas (required for the sentence to be useful)
Optionally refine links to specific Meanings or Surface Forms
Add Pronunciations (audio) to help learners hear the sentence spoken
Verify the sentence appears correctly and demonstrates proper usage
